content: Neural extractive summarization models: Cheng&Lapata BIBREF2 and SummaRuNNer BIBREF17 . Based on BIBREF18 , we use the Average Word Encoder as sentence encoder for both models, instead of the CNN and RNN sentence encoders that were originally used in the two systems, respectively.
